title: HF Viewer Launches Browser Utility Converting Hugging Face Models into Interactive Architecture Graphs
summary: A simple URL swap trick transforms complex PyTorch and SafeTensors configs into explorable node-link architecture graphs with tensor dimensions and FLOPs inspectors.
content:
Machine learning visualizer team Embedl has launched HF Viewer (hfviewer.com), a web utility and Chrome extension that converts any Hugging Face model repository into an interactive structural architecture graph.

### The Instant URL Swap Trick
Rather than downloading gigabytes of weights or reading nested Python module definitions to understand model topology, developers can simply replace 'huggingface.co' with 'hfviewer.com' in any browser address bar (e.g., https://hfviewer.com/meta-llama/Llama-3-8B).

### Interactive Model Inspection
The viewer features:
• **Multi-Level Granularity**: Smoothly zoom between high-level macro blocks (encoder/decoder stacks) and fine-grained micro layers (RMSNorm, SwiGLU, Rotary Embeddings).
• **Tensor Dimensions & FLOPs Inspector**: Click any layer or connection line to reveal parameter shapes, attention head counts, and compute footprints.
• **Presentation Hotkeys**: Fullscreen presentation mode ('F') and interactive laser pointer ('L') built for technical architecture reviews and team walkthroughs.

HF Viewer is completely free and requires zero login, API keys, or command-line setup.
